name: audio_out
doc: Who consumes one AudioOut's queue (src/audio/out.ts): nxnative's state, backend, start_phase and stalled / retry fields as one machine. Stopped: nobody; the guest-visible state is Stopped here and Started everywhere else. SilentStarting: the silent sink consumes on the guest clock while the device is asked to run (an AudioContext waits for a user gesture as long as it takes; with no device attached this state lasts); it carries when the attempt began and the backoff reached. Live: the device mixer consumes. SilentRetry: the device failed to start, delivered no callback within 1 s of running, stopped calling back for 200 ms or was taken away; the silent sink consumes and the device is asked again at the time the state carries, 1, 2, 4, 8, 8 ... s apart. Suspended: the page is hidden; the silent sink consumes and nothing is retried. Reaching Live or Stopped forgets the backoff.

SilentStarting.name: attempt
SilentStarting.type: host microseconds when the attempt began << 4 | backoff index (0 = none, 1..4 = 1, 2, 4, 8 s)

SilentRetry.name: retry
SilentRetry.type: host microseconds of the next attempt << 4 | backoff index (1..4)
